g.text: Data model: the Iceberg tables, their keys and partitions

text.tspan: All tables are Iceberg format v2 in the REST catalog lake, data on RustFS (s3://lakehouse/warehouse).
key: the logical key (unique bronze coordinates and silver event_id are asserted by lakestream check;
gold keys are the GROUP BY of each table). partition: the table is partitioned by days() of this column.
Bronze appends carry ingest.run_id, batch_id, consumer_group, topic, offsets, records, dlq_records
in the snapshot summary; gold tables are replaced in one snapshot per run with the property run_id.
